title: capsicum tomentosum
intro: Capsicum tomentosum, commonly known as the "woolly pepper" or "tomillo", is a species of flowering plant in the nightshade family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain and fever, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Capsicum tomentosum include capsaicinoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
